run.procedureSummary: Feed: add the cycle's table row to each chamber, whatever its state and ignoring capacity. Carry: go through chambers 1 to 6 in order; anything over a chamber's capacity moves to the next chamber (which can then overflow in its turn); chamber 6's excess goes to the loss tally. Check (on the quantities after carry): LARVAL at or above its upper mark becomes PUPAL; PUPAL at or below its lower mark goes back to LARVAL; anything else stays as it is; each change is logged. Metabolise: work out every chamber's share first, from the post-carry quantities and states after the check, rounding down. LARVAL burns floor(q/4) to loss. PUPAL passes floor(q/2) to the chamber before it, and chamber 1's PUPAL share goes to loss. Apply all shares at once, with no capacity check (any overfill waits for the next cycle's carry). Moult: if the six chambers total strictly more than 38 after metabolise, each chamber keeps floor(q/2) and the rest goes to loss; the cycle is logged.

openPoints.assumption: Strictly greater than 38. Cycle 5 ends metabolise on exactly 38, so no moult fires there.

openPoints.point: Which quantities Check uses, and whether a state changed by Check applies in the same cycle's Metabolise
openPoints.assumption: Check uses the post-carry quantities. Metabolise uses the states as they stand after Check in that same cycle.

openPoints.point: What 'half' a PUPAL chamber passes back is half of
openPoints.assumption: floor of the chamber's own quantity at the start of Metabolise, worked out before anything moves (so a chamber receiving from the one after it does not change its own share).
Not enforced. A chamber can sit above capacity until the next Feed and Carry, and after cycle 5 the end quantities stand as they are (chamber 2 ends at 10 against capacity 8).
Each chamber keeps floor(q/2) on its own; the discarded amount is the total before halving minus the total after, and it goes to the loss tally.
